html:
/* Template:MainPage/styles.css  -  the LAYOUT of the Main Page (sizes, grids, hero).
   The colours of the cards, tiles, lists and headings live in MediaWiki:Citizen.css, because they change with
   the light / dark theme and this stylesheet cannot do that. */

/* ---- hero ---- */
.aa-mp-hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 380px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 48px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(60% 70% at 18% 25%, rgba(110, 86, 150, .75), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(55% 60% at 85% 20%, rgba(224, 138, 54, .8), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(60% 50% at 88% 75%, rgba(84, 182, 178, .6), transparent 70%),
    #2a2623;
}
/* the artwork: put it in the hero with [[File:Main_hero.jpg]] (see the Main Page text) */
.aa-mp-hero img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center top;
}
.aa-mp-hero::before {   /* the darkening over the artwork */
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20, 18, 16, .35), rgba(20, 18, 16, .6) 60%, rgba(20, 18, 16, .88));
}
.aa-mp-herocopy {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}
.aa-mp-title {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: clamp(38px, 7vw, 66px);
  line-height: 1.05;
  color: #ececec;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
}
.aa-mp-tag {
  margin: 6px 0 16px;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-size: clamp(18px, 3vw, 24px);
  color: #d2d0cb;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
}
.aa-mp-search {
  width: min(460px, 100%);
  margin: 0 auto 18px;
}
.aa-mp-search a,
.aa-mp-search .citizen-search-trigger {
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  padding: 11px 16px 11px 42px;
  border: 1px solid #5a4d44;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(20, 18, 16, .72);
  color: #b9b3a8;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.aa-mp-search a:hover,
.aa-mp-search .citizen-search-trigger:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
  border-color: #e28552;
  color: #ececec;
}
.aa-mp-search a::before,
.aa-mp-search .citizen-search-trigger::before {            /* the magnifying glass: a ring ... */
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 15px;
  top: 12px;
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.aa-mp-search a::after,
.aa-mp-search .citizen-search-trigger::after {             /* ... and its handle */
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 27px;
  top: 25px;
  width: 7px;
  height: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.aa-mp-buttons {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  justify-content: center;
}
.aa-mp-buttons a {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 11px 20px;
  border: 1px solid #5a4d44;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(20, 18, 16, .55);
  color: #ececec;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.aa-mp-buttons a:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
  filter: brightness(1.15);
}
.aa-mp-buttons .aa-mp-main a {
  background: #e28552;
  border-color: #e28552;
  color: #fff;
}

/* ---- sections ---- */
.aa-mp-eyebrow {
  margin-top: 28px;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.aa-mp-h {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 30px;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

/* ---- the three cards ---- */
.aa-mp-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}
.aa-mp-card {
  border-width: 1px;
  border-style: solid;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-mp-card a {
  display: block;
}
.aa-mp-card a:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
}
.aa-mp-pic {
  display: block;
  height: 100px;
}
.aa-mp-pic {
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-mp-pic .mw-default-size,
.aa-mp-pic .mw-default-size > a,
.aa-mp-pic > a {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
}
.aa-mp-pic img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: 50% 10%;   /* 0% = top of the picture, 100% = bottom */
}
/* trim: the picture itself has a thin white edge at the top and bottom; make it a little taller than the card and shift it up, so the edges fall outside */
.aa-mp-pic.aa-mp-pic-trim img {
  position: relative;
  top: -4px;
  height: calc(100% + 8px);
}
.aa-mp-pic-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c9783f, #6a4a8c); }
.aa-mp-pic-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d2a93f, #7a5a2a); }
.aa-mp-pic-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3f8f9a, #3a4a7a); }
.aa-mp-cardtitle {
  display: block;
  padding: 8px 14px 0;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 21px;
}
.aa-mp-cardsub {
  display: block;
  padding: 0 14px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

/* ---- tiles (races, skill trees) ---- */
.aa-mp-tiles {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}
.aa-mp-tile {
  border-width: 1px;
  border-style: solid;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.aa-mp-tile a {
  color: inherit;
}
.aa-mp-tile a:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
}
/* the skill tree icons: all come from one picture (File:Skill.png). Each tile shows a window onto its own spot of it. */
.aa-mp-ico {
  position: relative;
  flex: none;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-mp-ico a,
.aa-mp-ico span {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.aa-mp-ico img {
  position: absolute;
  max-width: none;
  width: 660px;
  height: auto;
}
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-1 img { left: -470px; top: -155px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-2 img { left: -511px; top: -155px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-3 img { left: -554px; top: -155px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-4 img { left: -597px; top: -155px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-5 img { left: -324px; top: -202px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-6 img { left: -366px; top: -202px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-7 img { left: -409px; top: -202px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-8 img { left: -451px; top: -202px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-9 img { left: -324px; top: -243px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-10 img { left: -366px; top: -243px; }
.aa-mp-ico.aa-ic-11 img { left: -409px; top: -243px; }

/* ---- the proficiency icons: one picture (File:Proficiency.png), each tile shows its own square of it ---- */
.aa-mp-sub {
  margin: 14px 0 8px;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 18px;
  opacity: .85;
}
.aa-mp-pico {
  position: relative;
  flex: none;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.aa-mp-pico a,
.aa-mp-pico span {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.aa-mp-pico img {
  position: absolute;
  max-width: none;
  width: 288px;
  height: auto;
}
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-1 img { left: -0px; top: -0px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-2 img { left: -48px; top: -0px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-3 img { left: -96px; top: -0px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-4 img { left: -144px; top: -0px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-5 img { left: -192px; top: -0px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-6 img { left: -240px; top: -0px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-7 img { left: -0px; top: -48px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-8 img { left: -48px; top: -48px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-9 img { left: -96px; top: -48px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-10 img { left: -144px; top: -48px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-11 img { left: -192px; top: -48px; }

.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-13 img { left: -0px; top: -96px; }

.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-15 img { left: -96px; top: -96px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-16 img { left: -144px; top: -96px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-17 img { left: -192px; top: -96px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-18 img { left: -240px; top: -96px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-19 img { left: -0px; top: -144px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-20 img { left: -48px; top: -144px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-21 img { left: -96px; top: -144px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-22 img { left: -144px; top: -144px; }
.aa-mp-pico.aa-pi-23 img { left: -192px; top: -144px; }

/* ---- the topic lists ---- */
.aa-mp-cols {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}
.aa-mp-list {
  border-width: 1px;
  border-style: solid;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 12px 16px 14px;
}
.aa-mp-listtitle {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 20px;
}
.aa-mp-list ul {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.aa-mp-list li {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 3px 0 3px 14px;
}
.aa-mp-list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 2px;
  top: .75em;
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.aa-mp-new {
  margin-left: 6px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #e28552;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
}

/* ---- Latest updates box ---- */
.aa-mp-news {
  margin: 18px 0 6px;
}
.aa-mp-news .aa-mp-listtitle {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 12px;
}
.aa-mp-newslink {
  font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.aa-mp-news li {
  padding-left: 0;
}
.aa-mp-news li::before {
  display: none;
}
.aa-mp-news li b {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 64px;
  margin-right: 8px;
  color: #e28552;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: .03em;
}

/* NEW label sits in the tile's top-right corner so it never pushes outside the card */
.aa-mp-tile {
  position: relative;
}
.aa-mp-tile .aa-mp-new {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  right: 4px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 4px;
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 14px;
}

/* tiles: a little less padding and a slightly smaller name, so long names like Construction stay inside the card */
.aa-mp-tile {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/* the whole tile / card is clickable: the name's link is stretched over the entire box */
.aa-mp-tile > a::after,
.aa-mp-card > a::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
}
.aa-mp-card {
  position: relative;
}

/* skill trees: exactly 5 per row (2 rows for 10 trees); fewer per row on narrow screens */
.aa-mp-tiles.aa-mp-tiles-5 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .aa-mp-tiles.aa-mp-tiles-5 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .aa-mp-tiles.aa-mp-tiles-5 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

/* Latest wiki updates (left) and the Game News card (right) side by side */
.aa-mp-newsrow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.7fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 18px 0 6px;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.aa-mp-newsrow .aa-mp-news {
  margin: 0;
}
.aa-mp-newsrow .aa-mp-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .aa-mp-newsrow {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
